name: Button and text stack
what: A glowing line fades in on a dark screen, swells and slides off to the left in a blur while a rounded button slides in from the right and climbs up. Two lines then rise in under it, the first light and the last word in a bright highlight colour with a glow.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f1-f10 the opening line fades in at the middle (grey to light, glowing); f17-f40 it swells to 1.55x (slow start and end); f36-f53 it slides off to the left (accelerating, then steady) with a horizontal blur; f45-f56 the button slides in from the right (decelerating); f56-f71 it climbs to the upper third (S-curve); f72-f80 the first line rises in from 12 % of the height below, blurred and faint to sharp; f76-f84 the highlighted line does the same; the last frames hold

tracks.name: opening line in
tracks.what: fades from grey to light, with a glow

tracks.name: opening line out
tracks.what: slides off to the left with a horizontal motion blur

tracks.name: button in
tracks.what: slides in from the right edge, blurred while it is fast

tracks.name: button climbs
tracks.what: rises from the middle to the upper third

tracks.name: first line up
tracks.what: rises in under the button, blurred and faint to sharp

tracks.name: last line up
tracks.what: the highlighted word rises in the same way, with a coloured glow

tracks.name: hold
tracks.what: button and lines stand still (the film grain moves)
